mechanism: St. John's wort induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially reducing metronidazole metabolism and increasing systemic exposure, while metronidazole may inhibit some metabolic pathways affecting SJW component clearance.
action: Monitor clinical efficacy of metronidazole and consider alternative antimicrobials or herbal supplements; counsel patient on interaction potential and watch for increased adverse effects.
